name: Medical Modifier
teaser: Easily adjust stats for medical items like med kits, surgical kits and more
description_html:
Medical Modifier

Easily configure medical items including the number of uses, the rate of use (for medkits), and the time is takes to use the item.

This mod was inspired by medical attention and was made to be used as a stop-gap until that much better mod was updated.

Override Options

By default all items are disables by detault, and values are arbitrarily set. Each item needs to enabled for affects to take place. Every medical item is included, and you simply need to configure the option to the desired value

Installation

Like most other mods, simply drop the contents of the zip file into root of your SPT install.

Bugs, Problems or Suggestions

If you find any bugs or problems, please leave a comment
